prereq: A mode and FollowRig available; no active hazard
steps: Enter A; record left/right fixed-outline home positions and active handles; verify initial overlap; check adjustable height/depth/spacing and horizontal range controls
expected: Fixed references remain stationary relative to local follow frame; active handles begin at neutral; only listed user-adjustable settings affect their placement; no Avatar-bone posture classification required

prereq: A-01 setup recorded; safe practice area
steps: Move each active handle separately in forward/back and lateral directions; vary hand height while holding lateral position constant
expected: Handle input projects to the configured local horizontal plane; vertical hand movement does not add an unapproved vertical drive component; fixed home remains visible

prereq: A range/dead-zone settings recorded; safe practice area
steps: Move active handle to just inside, at, and beyond configured range in several horizontal directions; repeat after adjusting user range
expected: Output stays within the configured finite range and dead-zone; no unexpected unbounded input; measured limits are recorded, not assumed

prereq: A controls paired; one input at a time
steps: Grip left and right handles separately; release each; then grip both, move forward/back asymmetrically and together
expected: Only the intended hand/handle engages; release returns that side toward neutral and removes its drive; combined inputs follow the documented A mapping without exceeding common movement limits

prereq: A controls paired; compatible tracked hand input
steps: Attempt grip near and away from active handle; record engage threshold behavior and grip offset; release and re-engage from a different hand pose
expected: Engagement behavior is clear and repeatable; handle does not jump from an unaccounted hand offset; unsupported pickup/track behavior is reported rather than hidden

prereq: A mode active; safe practice area; tracking-loss trigger can be reproduced safely
steps: While driving, temporarily invalidate one hand then both hands' tracking using a safe test condition; restore tracking without restarting round
expected: Invalid tracking clears affected drive; no stale acceleration persists; on recovery input starts neutral until deliberate re-engagement

prereq: A mode active; menu can be opened safely
steps: Drive both handles, open platform menu, wait, close menu, observe drive before touching controls
expected: Menu state clears/neutralizes movement and prevents repeated Jump; closing menu does not restore stale drive without fresh input

prereq: B mode available; left-stick binding and common movement limits recorded
steps: Apply neutral, cardinal, and diagonal left-stick inputs in a safe area; release between trials
expected: Input creates intended 2D ball-path intent; diagonal normalization/dead-zone behavior is recorded; no claim of tested responsiveness without logs

prereq: B mode available; camera and movement heading observable
steps: Move with left stick while turning head independently; then test right-stick horizontal input in both directions
expected: Head look alone does not unexpectedly redirect movement intent; right-stick behavior follows actual implementation, recorded separately from HMD look

prereq: Test device supports configurable native comfort turning; record exact setting
steps: Repeat right-stick horizontal input with native comfort turning enabled and disabled; inspect input events and resulting reference yaw
expected: Conflicts, duplicate turning, missing axes, or changed semantics are recorded; do not assume InputLookHorizontal/comfort-turn events are identical

prereq: Desktop bindings shown by tested build; common movement limits recorded
steps: Test neutral, cardinal, diagonal, and release for configured movement keys; inspect mouse look/reference behavior independently
expected: Desktop controls produce same bounded movement intent and common motion model as VR modes; exact bindings and mouse coupling match the tested build, not a guessed default

prereq: Same build/ruleset; equivalent test environment and common output instrumentation
steps: Apply matched normalized movement intentions across A, B, and Desktop; compare requested intent and resulting speed/turn caps
expected: Different devices may differ in raw input, but no mode bypasses the common movement cap or gains unbounded speed from hand motion/keyboard saturation

prereq: At least two modes can be entered; safe switching path identified
steps: Drive in one mode; switch to another using supported flow; observe output before new input; repeat reverse order
expected: Mode transition clears old mode input and does not carry stale acceleration/turn; new mode starts neutral and requires fresh intentional input

prereq: Live drive; menu or focus-loss condition available
steps: Apply drive, open menu or remove focus, wait, restore focus; do not touch input until observing state
expected: Menu/focus loss clears movement and action state; no queued/delayed unintended action on return

prereq: Match active; a test power-up is held; actual Jump event/binding observable
steps: Press configured Jump once and release; record action count; hold continuously; release and press a second time
expected: One activation per rising edge; holding does not retrigger; a new press after release may activate once if still valid; held item state changes only on authoritative confirmation

prereq: Player in Station; Disable Station Exit and jump suppression configured only if supported; power-up held
steps: Use Jump once, hold it, repeat after release; inspect default jump behavior and whether player exits Station
expected: Jump action does not unexpectedly jump or exit Station; if platform cannot reliably separate action from exit/default jump, mark BLOCKED/unsupported and escalate; do not assume listener intercepts input

prereq: Match active; no power-up held
steps: Press Jump once and hold; inspect feedback and Station state
expected: Empty slot gives at most the intended light feedback; no hidden activation, repeated effect, default jump, or Station exit

prereq: In-round participant; active input; KO scenario can be triggered safely
steps: Apply drive, trigger a valid KO, record input state, roster state, cleanup, and eventual respawn separately
expected: KO clears movement/held action and temporary effects as designed, but does not treat the participant as voluntarily departed; confirmed match/score semantics follow the tested build

prereq: In-round participant; before-settings snapshot recorded; explicit leave-match UI available
steps: Apply input, choose Leave Match, verify confirmation, Station release/safe return and each saved player setting after leaving
expected: Explicit voluntary leave removes player from current-round participation as designed; input clears; original player movement/height/jump-related settings restore without overwriting unrelated preferences

prereq: In-round or Station state; before-settings snapshot recorded; platform Respawn can be safely invoked
steps: Apply input, invoke VRChat platform Respawn through approved test procedure; inspect cleanup, re-entry/roster outcome, and restored settings
expected: Platform Respawn is distinct from KO and voluntary leave; no stuck Station/input; original settings restore or a concrete platform limitation is documented

prereq: Round-ending or reset path available; before-settings snapshot recorded
steps: Apply input and end/reset round normally; inspect Station release, input clearing, safe return and settings
expected: Round end/reset clears temporary controls and restores player settings; it is not mislabeled as KO or user-initiated leave

prereq: Recovery/reset path reproducible in a controlled test; owner/recovery responsibilities documented
steps: Enter recovery/reset while input is non-neutral; observe input lock, safe fallback/cancel path and post-recovery settings
expected: Recovery does not preserve stale drive or strand player; successful recovery/cancellation has a clear restore owner and restores settings; do not infer match result from missing state

prereq: Volunteer participant consents; short low-risk trial; observer present; baseline comfort options available
steps: After non-human checks pass, conduct a short A trial; record reported comfort, arm fatigue, visibility, calibration time; stop immediately on discomfort
expected: No pass/fail comfort claim from one run; participant may stop or skip any action without penalty; stop event is recorded without medical diagnosis

prereq: Volunteer participant consents; short low-risk trial; observer present; baseline comfort options available
steps: After non-human checks pass, conduct a short B trial with selected turn setting; record comfort, fatigue, visibility and stop feedback
expected: No “comfortable/non-dizzy” guarantee; participant may stop immediately; compare settings only with informed consent and no pressure to endure
